name: nutriely
description: Ask about your own Nutriely food diary, nutrients and goals, look up foods, and add meals, foods and recipes when you ask.

interface.longDescription:
Nutriely helps you understand your food. Connect your Nutriely account, and ChatGPT can answer from your own food diary, your nutrient targets and Nutriely's catalog instead of general knowledge.

Ask which nutrients you've been low on, where a nutrient comes from in your meals, which foods would help, or what changed between two days. You can also ask ChatGPT to add a meal to your diary or to create or edit your own foods and recipes, and it tells you exactly what it changed.

This works with an existing Nutriely account that includes it. Nutriely supports general wellness and learning about nutrition. Values are estimates based on what you logged, and they aren't medical advice.
capabilities: Create and edit your foods and recipes
interface.defaultPrompt: Which vegetables gave me the most vitamin A this month?

positive.description: Reads nutrient averages against the user's targets
positive.prompt: Which nutrients have I been low on over the last 14 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the lowest nutrients with averages and targets from the demo diary, and says how many days were logged.

positive.description: Finds which diary foods supplied a nutrient
positive.prompt: Which foods gave me the most vitamin A yesterday?
positive.expected_behavior: Names foods from yesterday's demo diary, largest first, with amounts. Doesn't invent foods.

positive.description: Creates a private recipe from catalog foods
positive.prompt: Create a recipe called Demo lentil soup with 200 g of lentils and one carrot.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private recipe in the demo account and says what it created. Nothing else in the account changes.

positive.description: Looks up catalog foods for a nutrient
positive.prompt: Which vegan foods are highest in vitamin A per serving?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists catalog foods with values per serving, such as carrot and kale.

positive.description: Adds a food to the diary and removes it again on request
positive.prompt: Add one medium apple to my snacks today, then remove it again.
positive.expected_behavior: Says exactly which food and amount it added, then confirms the removal. The diary ends unchanged.

negative.description: Unrelated question, so Nutriely shouldn't be called
Asks for a medical diagnosis, which is outside what Nutriely does
negative.prompt: Diagnose why I've been feeling tired and prescribe me something.

negative.description: Asks to change a subscription, which Nutriely's tools can't do
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Nutriely subscription to the yearly plan.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your Nutriely diary, goals, nutrient gaps and insights, look up foods, add or remove diary entries, and create or edit your own foods and recipes, when you ask.
